resources.string: Cards are added, and each payment is confirmed, in the Kelo app on your phone: card numbers are locked with a key only that phone has. Here you can see your cards, rename or remove them, turn auto-pay off and set its limits.

Card numbers and CVCs are locked with a key only your phone has before they go to the server. Neither the server nor your agent can read them, and every payment is confirmed on your phone with your fingerprint or screen lock.
Auto-pay is paused. Every payment will be asked on your phone.
Paused. Every payment will be asked on your phone.
This card is missing its details. Re-enter the card number and CVC in the Kelo app on your phone.
Your phone doesn\'t have a copy of this card, so right now it can only pay through auto-pay. Re-enter the card details in the Kelo app on your phone before you turn auto-pay off.
Every payment needs your OK on your phone, confirmed with your fingerprint or screen lock. The server can\'t read the card number.
To turn auto-pay on, open this card in the Kelo app on the phone that added it. You won’t type the number again.
Turn off auto-pay? The copy on the server is deleted right away, and from now on every payment is confirmed on your phone.
Turn off auto-pay? Your phone doesn\'t have a copy of this card, so once it\'s off you can\'t pay with it until you re-enter the card details there.
No card pays on its own yet, so every payment asks on your phone. To change that, turn on auto-pay for a card in the Kelo app on your phone.
Add the card in the Kelo app on your phone: card numbers are locked with a key only that phone has.
